mapper.select: SELECT address_id, receiver, mobile, province, city, district, detail, is_default FROM user_address WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, address_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_address (user_id, receiver, mobile, province, city, district, detail, is_default, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{receiver}, #{mobile}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{detail}, #{isDefault}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE user_address SET is_default = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_address WHERE address_id = #{addressId} AND user_id = #{userId}
